name: Philistine Gag Reel: Cooking with Hellfire
source:
When serving an archduchess of Hell, one would expect her assignments to be....hellish?

Fortunately for the Half Devil Priam and his superior, Persephone, all they've got to do is prepare her the Thrycian Original; Pumpkin Cake.

Though in Hell, anything can happen. The way of promotion usually results from the downfall of another. And Priam has been trying to escape for quite some time. That, and this might be the perfect opportunity for a snake to rear its ugly head

But it's just Pumpkin Cake. You don't need to be culinarian extraordinaire to pull this off. Perhaps there's nothing to worry about. Or maybe they need to be afraid?

[From [url=https://ultrashiko.itch.io/philistine-gag-reel-cooking-with-hellfire]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
侍奉地狱大公夫人时，你会以为她交代的任务一定……十分地狱吧？

所幸，半恶魔Priam和他的上司Persephone只需要为她准备一道“Thrycian Original”南瓜蛋糕。

不过在地狱里，什么都有可能发生。晋升通常意味着另一个人失势，而Priam早就想逃走了。除此之外，这或许也是一条毒蛇露出丑恶面目的绝佳机会。

可这只是一块南瓜蛋糕。做好它又不需要成为顶级厨师。也许没什么好担心的……又或许，他们真的该害怕？

[来源：[url=https://ultrashiko.itch.io/philistine-gag-reel-cooking-with-hellfire]Itch.io[/url]]
